dependency_findings: REQUIRES core/artifact_registry.py to support structured manifest objects before EAP layer can be authoritative

to.rationale: EAP is the authoritative delivery manifest and is a blocking prerequisite for both the build pipeline (A3) and the runtime compiler (A5). It naturally extends the existing artifact_registry and delivery modules. Not a new component because those modules already cover the responsibility boundaries.
assumptions: core/artifact_registry.py already stores sufficient metadata to derive an EAP manifest
The EAP format is a superset of existing file-manifest.json entries, not a separate store
Versioning uses semver with backward-compatible read for at least one prior major version
Validator runs synchronously at packaging time, not as a background process
risks: EAP schema must be stable before dependent items (0398, 0399) build on it; schema churn could cascade
Compatibility rules across EAP versions may be under-specified leading to brittle validators
Existing artifact_registry may not carry sufficient metadata for full EAP composition without modification
